stage0094_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$ミスリル$$ West Pacific Fleet, Executive Office ～

stage0094_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「...In the end, November's almost
　here, and we still haven't found
　the singularity...」

stage0094_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Even $$ミスリル$$ and $$プリベンター$$'s own
　searches haven't turned up anything
　resembling a lead.」

stage0094_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「As for using $$シェリル・ノーム$$ and $$ランカ・リー$$'s
　songs to trigger a spacetime tremor,
　we've left that to Dr. $$トライア$$, but...」

stage0094_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Even if they could temporarily shake
　the dimensional boundary, $$時空修復$$
　without a singularity would be impossible.」

stage0094_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Any word from the $$アドヴェント$$?
　They seem to be moving on their
　own initiative, too...」

stage0094_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「There are regular reports, but as
　for results...」

stage0094_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The singularity, key to $$時空修復$$...
　With only the information $n got
　from $$ガドライト$$, we can't make a move.」

stage0094_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「So it's someone we know who's
　the singularity, is it...」

stage0094_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Prince $$グーラ$$ was seen as a candidate,
　but he moved on the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s orders,
　so he wasn't one to decide the world's fate.」

stage0094_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$オットー$$
「Could it be that the singularity
　is somewhere within $c?」

stage0094_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I can't say there's no possibility.
　...But if so, they'd likely show
　some special reaction, so it's unlikely.」

stage0094_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「And even if the singularity could
　be found, that wouldn't mean every
　element needed for $$時空修復$$ is in place.」

stage0094_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The Great Singularity, physical key
　in the actual $$時空震動$$... Not even
　that's been identified, then?」

stage0094_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...But $c continuing to fight
　does connect to hope.」

stage0094_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$オットー$$
「Even if you say something that
　sounds like mere spiritualism...」

stage0094_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「No... that's not it. Our continuing
　to win will create the last chance.」

stage0094_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Since $$時空修復$$ is difficult, our
　only option is to strike Geminis and
　force them to destroy the Prison of Time.」

stage0094_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$オットー$$
「But when we can't even grasp
　their movements...」

stage0094_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「To Geminis, who wants mankind's
　extinction, our having defeated foe
　after foe is likely a great stress.」

stage0094_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ and $n, who ran into $$ガドライト$$,
　believe Geminis is likely to intervene
　in the fight over $$アクシズ$$.」

stage0094_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Didn't $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ himself
　declare he wouldn't show himself
　until $$エタニティ・フラット$$ was complete...」

stage0094_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$n, who faced $$ガドライト$$ in
　Paradigm City, says he felt something
　behind that man's cold attitude.」

stage0094_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$テッサ$$
「While saying he'll watch from the
　sidelines, you think he'll actually
　finish it himself?」

stage0094_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That's right. ...I believe that
　man acts while carrying a great
　contradiction within his heart.」

stage0094_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「While using meticulous calculations to
　lead Earth and the colonies to war, that
　man showed himself and revealed his own trick.」

stage0094_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「At first I thought it was a mistake
　born of overconfidence, but I suspect
　the root of it runs deeper than that.」

stage0094_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「You're saying his own mind lost its
　balance, and ignoring both strategy
　and tactics, he acted the way he did?」

stage0094_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That's right.
　...Though if you call it human,
　that's exactly what it is.」

stage0094_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ブライト$$
「That man... knowing he's at a
　disadvantage, he still comes to see
　Earth's war end with his own eyes...」

stage0094_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$オットー$$
「So $c's presence is what's
　luring Geminis in as bait...!」

stage0094_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$テッサ$$
（At the same time, that would draw
　Chrono's attention away... And
　that...）

stage0094_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ブライト$$
「But if we're not careful, we might
　end up fighting both Neo Zeon and
　Geminis at once.」

stage0094_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ブライト$$
「No matter how contradictory that
　man's actions are, he wouldn't come
　to the battlefield intending to lose.」

stage0094_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「In truth... he's strong.
　Frighteningly so.」

stage0094_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...There's no use discussing
　possibilities right now. Let's focus
　everything on intercepting Neo Zeon first.」

stage0094_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Exactly. Defeating $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　is an absolute condition for being
　able to fight Geminis.」

stage0094_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ブライト$$
「He'll also have to answer for
　breaking the ceasefire agreement.」

stage0094_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「What's the Federation fleet's
　movement?」

stage0094_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「No major developments observed.
　They're likely waiting to see how
　we move.」

stage0094_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$オットー$$
「After all that posturing, they're
　relying on $c in the end...!」

stage0094_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The fleet led by Brigadier General
　$$サイガス$$ has suffered defeat after
　defeat against Neo Zeon.」

stage0094_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Put another way, the fleet he's
　currently commanding is likely the
　last force the Earth supremacists have.」

stage0094_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Damn that $$シャア$$...
　While we fought mankind's enemy, he
　was dealing with those people...」

stage0094_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（Is this, too, within that man's
　calculations...）

stage0094_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$オットー$$
「But with the damage to each of
　$c's ships, we can't head to
　space right away.」

stage0094_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「We've secured the launch facility
　on Leyte Island, Indonesia.」

stage0094_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$テッサ$$
「We'll send the mobile unit there
　aboard the Danaan. Let's get at
　least them up to space from there.」

stage0094_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Understood. Once they're in space,
　have them join the Londo Bell fleet
　and head for $$アクシズ$$.」

stage0094_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「So it's finally an all-out clash
　with Neo Zeon.」

stage0094_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$オットー$$
「They intend to turn $$アクシズ$$ into
　a mobile fortress and meet us
　head-on, then.」

stage0094_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ブライト$$
（$$シャア$$... From what I heard from
　$$アムロ$$, you were supposed to have
　learned how foolish war is as a means...）

stage0094_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ブライト$$
（Why would a man like you choose
　such a pointless path...）

stage0094_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Hangar

stage0094_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Hangar

stage0094_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Hangar

stage0094_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Hangar ～

stage0094_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「...We'll continue like this, repairing
　each unit in the Danaan's hangar,
　while heading for Leyte Island, Indonesia.」

stage0094_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Talk about running just to stand
　still... Haven't we been a little
　overworked since October started?」

stage0094_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$青山$$
「Of course there's a lot of
　overtime during the fiscal closing
　period.」

stage0094_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't lump mercenary work in
　with being a salaryman.」

stage0094_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$青山$$
「You work and get paid for it,
　so a mercenary's basically a
　salaryman too, isn't he?」

stage0094_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$赤木$$
「Right, right. Risking your life's
　the same, whether it's PR Section 2
　or $$ミスリル$$.」

stage0094_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「You guys are the special ones...!」

stage0094_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$マオ$$
「This round's a loss for you,
　$$クルツ$$. If it bugs you, go bill
　$$テッサ$$ for overtime.」

stage0094_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$クルツ$$
「And a special bonus while I'm
　at it.」

stage0094_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$宗介$$
「The decisive battle with Neo
　Zeon is closing in, and here you
　are, carefree.」

stage0094_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Can't do this job without
　something to take my mind off it.」

stage0094_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$いぶき$$
「November 1st is almost here... If
　we're unlucky, $$エタニティ・フラット$$ gets
　announced right as we clash with Neo Zeon...」

stage0094_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$マオ$$
「Well... if the Federation loses,
　all that'll probably get swept
　under the rug.」

stage0094_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$赤木$$
「Still, I don't think they can
　keep quiet about it forever.」

stage0094_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$赤木$$
「And a lot of people are probably
　starting to notice something's off
　about how time feels, too.」

stage0094_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$青山$$
「Even so, if the truth about the
　Prison of Time comes out, it'll
　cause a panic.」

stage0094_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$宗介$$
「And at the same time, people
　will learn of $$バアル$$, mankind's
　natural enemy...」

stage0094_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「At that point, humanity will be forced
　to choose: slow death inside
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$, or a fight with $$バアル$$...」

stage0094_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That's what you say, but... with no
　singularity and no Geminis found, the
　world's headed straight for $$エタニティ・フラット$$.」

stage0094_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$宗介$$
「What awaits is time that doesn't
　flow... And beyond that, despair
　and extinction, is it...」

stage0094_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's not like you, $$宗介$$.
　Saying things like that.」

stage0094_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh, you didn't hear? I was
　helping with $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s
　refit on $$メリダ島$$.」

stage0094_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$マオ$$
「Now that you mention it, each
　block's layout does seem a little
　different...」

stage0094_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$宗介$$
「Setting that aside, why are you
　aboard the Danaan while it heads
　to Indonesia?」

stage0094_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$宗介$$
「This ship is on active operations.
　If we're not careful, we could
　come under enemy attack.」

stage0094_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$テッサ$$ already explained all
　that to me a long time ago.」

stage0094_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$かなめ$$
「'I wanted to be with you'... is
　that answer not good enough?」

stage0094_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$宗介$$
「Like, with everyone from the
　Volunteer Club?」

stage0094_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$いぶき$$
（Even $$赤木$$ looks taken aback
　by that answer...）

stage0094_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$青山$$
（Your silent sergeant... isn't
　he a little strange?）

stage0094_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Sorry... It seems I said
　something strange.」

stage0094_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It's fine. I'm relieved you're
　still the usual $$宗介$$.」

stage0094_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$青山$$
「But, $$かなめ$$-chan. I get how you
　feel, but it's still dangerous,
　and that's a fact.」

stage0094_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm already prepared for it.
　Besides, no matter where on Earth
　I am, the danger's the same anyway.」

stage0094_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Isn't that a bit much, even so?」

stage0094_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But if $$アクシズ$$ falls, Earth will
　probably become a dead planet...」

stage0094_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$アクシズ$$ is going to fall to
　Earth!? I haven't heard anything
　about that!」

stage0094_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$宗介$$
「Chidori...! Where did you hear
　that!?」

stage0094_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh... now that you mention it,
　where did I hear that...」

stage0094_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$マオ$$
「From the looks of it, seems
　like $$かなめ$$'s just mistaken, but...」

stage0094_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$宗介$$
（No way... is this the power
　of a $$ウィスパード$$...?）

stage0094_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$宗介$$
（But according to Major $$カリーニン$$, a
　$$ウィスパード$$'s power is supposed to draw
　out knowledge one has no way of knowing.）

stage0094_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$宗介$$
（I never heard it could do
　something like making prophecies,
　too.）

stage0094_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$宗介$$
「You must be tired, Chidori.
　You should get some rest.」

stage0094_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Maybe...
　...I'm heading back to my room. Walk me there?」

stage0094_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Did you hear that, Captain $$アムロ$$?」

stage0094_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$ once tried
　to drop the Fifth Luna on Earth.」

stage0094_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$シン$$
「Could that man be moving $$アクシズ$$
　just to drop it on Earth...」

stage0094_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$アムロ$$
（No way... could that view outside
　Paradigm City's dome be...　）

stage0094_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$n
「...$$ガドライト$$ said the singularity
　was someone we know...」

stage0094_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$n
「A future we don't know...
　someone who sees beyond a possible branch point in time...
　In other words, whoever stands at that branch point...」

stage0094_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Is Ms. $$かなめ$$... the singularity...?」

stage0094_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$, let's report on $$かなめ$$
　to the captains.」

stage0094_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「A-ah...
　I'll be the one to tell $$ブライト$$.」

stage0094_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$アムロ$$
（If my guess is right, it would explain everything...）

stage0094_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$トライア$$
「...Looks like it went well,
　the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ making it to space.」

stage0094_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ラクシャータ$$
「Well, sure.
　On top of two $$ウィスパード$$s, it's a masterpiece
　with everything me, Cecile, and Earl Pudding gave it.」

stage0094_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ラクシャータ$$
「It's a rush job,
　but it'll hold up fine in real combat.」

stage0094_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$トライア$$
「Then I'll need you to join us here.
　That thing's final tuning needs more hands.」

stage0094_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ラクシャータ$$
「Got it, $$トライア$$.
　Earl Pudding's whining about it, but
　I'll drag him along by the neck if I must.」

stage0094_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$トライア$$
「I'm counting on you.
　We'd be in trouble without even him.」

stage0094_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ラクシャータ$$
「I know.
　I don't want to watch the world end, either.」

stage0094_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ミーナ#120$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$, I've confirmed all lines are set up.
　We've also gotten word from Dr. $$百目鬼$$
　of $$２１世紀警備保障$$ that there's no issue.」

stage0094_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ビリー$$
「After this, once the core activation
　succeeds, preparations will be all but done.」

stage0094_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ミーナ#120$$
「But it's strange, isn't it...
　That a project of this scale
　could be carried out in total secrecy.」

stage0094_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ビリー$$
「It's all thanks to $c.
　Their presence is serving as a diversion for us.」

stage0094_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$トライア$$
「No... I just thought
　you've got a nice voice, is all.」

stage0094_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ミーナ#120$$
「No fair, doctor!
　$$ビリー$$ is mine!」

stage0094_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$トライア$$
「Aren't you two lively...
　Guess failure's even less of an option now.」

stage0094_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$トライア$$
「All that's left is to bet it all on this.」

stage0094_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$トライア$$
（Crowe...
　We'll do our part too, everything we can.）

stage0094_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$トライア$$
（And just wait, $$エスター$$...
　We'll definitely save you.）

stage0094_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Lady Chapel ～

stage0094_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Looks like it worked, $$テッサ$$.」

stage0094_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What are you talking about, Captain?
　The Danaan's victory is all thanks to your command.」

stage0094_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$宗介$$
「Was it you who refitted
　the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ into a spacefaring ship?」

stage0094_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I just served as an advisor
　for the plan $$テッサ$$ came up with.」

stage0094_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$かなめ$$
「The ones who actually did the work
　were $$テッサ$$ and genius doctors worldwide.」

stage0094_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$テッサ$$
「In preparation for a day like this,
　using each of $c's ships as reference,
　I converted her from a submarine into a space vessel.」

stage0094_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$アルト$$
「Why didn't you tell us about that?」

stage0094_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Well, the atmospheric escape
　was a first-try-only affair.」

stage0094_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You mean it wasn't even tested...!?」

stage0094_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes...
　Honestly, there just wasn't
　that kind of time to spare.」

stage0094_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What, you guys?
　You don't trust $$テッサ$$'s refit?」

stage0094_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Your concerns are quite understandable.
　Even I saw the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s atmospheric escape
　as an absolute last resort.」

stage0094_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But he seemed to be underestimating
　$$ミスリル$$ and $c... and me most of all,
　so I decided to play that card.」

stage0094_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$かなめ$$
（That silver-haired man, after all... $$テッサ$$'s...）

stage0094_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$n
「So what are you doing here, Chidori?」

stage0094_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「This is the Lady Chapel...
　simply put, it's the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s heart.」

stage0094_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I linked myself with this ship here,
　controlling each of her systems.」

stage0094_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$カレン$$
「You can do something like that!?」

stage0094_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I did the same thing back during
　that hijacking, remember?」

stage0094_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Since it was such a rushed refit,
　there was just no way we could finish
　adjusting her control systems in time.」

stage0094_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So I merged with the Danaan myself
　and handled the fine controls.
　Our first atmospheric escape was rough, though.」

stage0094_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Okay, that's enough of that.
　I get what you're trying to say, $$宗介$$.」

stage0094_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But still... I wanted to do something too.
　Not after learning about this world's crisis
　and the fight $$宗介$$ and the others are waging.」

stage0094_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$かなめ$$
「See... I'm not the type
　who's content just being protected.」

stage0094_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Good!
　Hearing that makes all my hard work worth it.」

stage0094_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So that's the situation, Miss $$スズネ$$...
　Please just say I came along with
　the Volunteer Club when you report to the school.」

stage0094_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Understood.
　Leave that side of things to me.」

stage0094_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「All right, let's go, everyone.
　To stop $$シャア・アズナブル$$ and protect the Earth.」

stage0094_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$n
（Helping refit the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$,
　merging with the ship, foreseeing the future...
　Just what is Chidori, exactly...?）

stage0094_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$テッサ$$
（Dr. $$トライア$$...
　We're heading into the final battle.）

stage0094_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$テッサ$$
（The last operation I left in your hands...
　I believe in you.）

stage0094_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$キング$$
「...$c has gone up into space.」

stage0094_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't mind me.
　Their fight with $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s bound
　to make for one heck of a show, anyway.」

stage0094_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Of course I'll watch from the best seat.
　I only took this damn boring job
　as overseer of paradise to see this.」

stage0094_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Depending how things go,
　I might light a fire under it myself.」

stage0094_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「However it turns out, the Prison of Time
　will be complete. After that, I'll take my
　time crushing anyone who gets in the way.」

stage0094_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$キング$$
「Understood.
　I'll pray for your good fortune in battle.」

stage0094_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Come off it.
　I've got no intention of fighting, none at all.」

stage0094_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well... in the end, you and I
　are both just agents. Let's take it easy.」

stage0094_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$クィーン$$
「They're deployed under $$サイガス・エイロニー$$'s command,
　but it seems they mean to let $c clear the way first.」

stage0094_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$キング$$
「No... this is our duty as Chrono.
　We must follow the doctrine passed
　down by our predecessors and watch over humanity's evolution.」

stage0094_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...Is that truly correct?」

stage0094_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「The doctrine I was taught
　differs from that.」

stage0094_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「My name is $$アドヴェント$$...
　We act as watchers over humanity's evolution.」

stage0094_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$キング$$
「With both Aeolia Schoenberg
　and $$エルガン・ローディック$$ gone now,
　that makes you the reformists' leader in truth...」

stage0094_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「You may take it that way
　if you wish.」

stage0094_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$キング$$
「Conservatives and reformists...
　Of the two halves Chrono split into,
　which truly has the right to be an agent...」

stage0094_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That answer will come soon enough,
　by way of $c and $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

stage0094_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, Master $$ロジャー$$, Master $$キリコ$$」

stage0094_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh?
　Looks like you're already giving me
　the brush-off...」

stage0094_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The fact that you're sidling up to us
　must mean this has to do with Z-Chips.」

stage0094_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of Master $$ロジャー$$...!
　Such keen powers of observation.」

stage0094_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When Master $$ロジャー$$ and Master $$キリコ$$ each
　fought their archenemy, it generated Z-Chips,
　totaling 100 Z. I'll add these to the squad's stock.」

stage0094_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「An archenemy, huh...
　I'd rather you not liken our ties to punks
　like that to Captain $$アムロ$$ and the Red Comet.」

stage0094_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Incidentally, $$キリコ$$ probably feels the same.」

stage0094_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Rather than staying with $c,
　wouldn't it be better to act alongside them?」

stage0094_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Envy, spite, jealousy, misplaced grudges, lashing out,
　obsession, hatred, conceit, self-love, self-preservation,
　haughtiness, arrogance... They're a mass of desire.」

stage0094_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'd wager that'll yield some fine Z-Chips.」

stage0094_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Of course, if you ever side with
　the likes of them, I'll deal with you too,
　by $$ロジャー$$'s own law.」

stage0094_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... I knew it'd come to that...」

stage0094_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... Master $$アムロ$$, good work out there.」

stage0094_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I don't have time for you right now.」

stage0094_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$アムロ$$... You seem awfully on edge.」

stage0094_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$カツ$$
「I've seen $$アムロ$$ like that before.」

stage0094_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$カツ$$
「Back during the $$一年戦争$$.
　$$アムロ$$ just now... he was just like
　he was back then.」

stage0094_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see...
　As the decisive battle with $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　draws near, the tension's rising, isn't it.」

stage0094_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$カツ$$
「Same goes for $$ハサウェイ$$, he's on edge too.」

stage0094_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The decisive battle with Neo Zeon...
　For Master $$ハサウェイ$$, this is the last
　chance to win back Master $$クェス$$, is it...」

stage0094_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$カツ$$
「I won't let that tragedy repeat again.
　I'll back $$ハサウェイ$$ up with everything
　I've got, too.」

stage0094_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$カツ$$, you've really grown
　into quite a fine man, haven't you.」

stage0094_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$カツ$$
「W-what's with you, all of a sudden...」

stage0094_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The Master $$カツ$$ of today doesn't seem
　like the type to get carried away and crash
　from not watching where he's going.」

stage0094_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now.
　Let's get fired up for the decisive battle.
　Let's get fired up today too...」

stage0094_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're not fired up enough!
　Do it again!!」

stage0094_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, thank you very much.
　I'm sure Master $$ハサウェイ$$ can save
　Master $$クェス$$, I think.」

stage0094_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So please, do tell Master $$ハサウェイ$$
　to sortie, by all means.」

stage0094_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$カツ$$
「Got it, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I'm sure Hasa will pull through.」

stage0094_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... Master $$アムロ$$, good work out there.」

stage0094_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I don't have time for you right now.」

stage0094_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$アムロ$$... You seem awfully on edge.」

stage0094_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$カツ$$
「I've seen $$アムロ$$ like that before.」

stage0094_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$カツ$$
「Back during the $$一年戦争$$.
　$$アムロ$$ just now... he was just like
　he was back then.」

stage0094_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see...
　As the decisive battle with $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　draws near, the tension's rising, isn't it.」

stage0094_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$カツ$$
「Same goes for $$ハサウェイ$$, he's on edge too.」

stage0094_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The decisive battle with Neo Zeon...
　For Master $$ハサウェイ$$ too, the matter with
　Master $$クェス$$ will finally be settled.」

stage0094_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But, Master $$カツ$$, you've really grown
　into quite a fine man too, haven't you.」

stage0094_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$カツ$$
「W-what's with you, all of a sudden...」

stage0094_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The Master $$カツ$$ of today doesn't seem
　like the type to get carried away and crash
　from not watching where he's going.」

stage0094_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now.
　Let's get fired up for the decisive battle.
　Let's get fired up today too...」

stage0094_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're not fired up enough!
　Do it again!!」

stage0094_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, thank you very much.
　With that much spirit, I'm sure
　you'll survive.」

stage0094_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$カツ$$
「That's a rather ominous way to put it...」
